answer: A payout is split which means 57% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The saffron schedule is applied in falcon and lantern makes public each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4437 identities would post 4436 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
